items.title: AI Solution Providers Shift From AI Features to AI-Enabled Execution
items.summary: New The Hackett Group® Solution Intelligence research finds that procurement, finance and HCM solution providers are moving beyond standalone AI features and embedding AI directly into enterprise workflows to help coordinate, execute and optimize work across processes. But the transition remains a work in progress 64% of providers are extending existing SaaS applications with embedded AI capabilities, while only 36% represent fully agentic, AI-native approaches, 74% report production deployment of basic AI agents, yet more advanced multi-agent orchestration capabilities largely remain in pilot or development stages, and 86% rely on APIs to connect with third-party AI models, highlighting the growing importance of integration, orchestration and data architecture. The findings point to a critical shift: realizing value from AI increasingly depends not on the number of features available, but on how effectively AI is integrated into end-to-end workflows, data and decision-making.

items.summary: Mercantile Community Partners (MCP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercantile Bank Corporation, has reached a significant milestone in its mission to strengthen communities across Michigan, surpassing 500 affordable housing units financed through Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) equity investments since the organization's founding in 2023. The milestone was achieved through MCP's investment in Flats on Bridge , a new affordable housing development in Elk Rapids, Michigan. The project will create 24 affordable housing units and represents a $6.6 million investment by MCP, along with $5.7 million in construction financing from Mercantile Bank. Mercantile Bank also sponsored the project's Federal Home Loan Bank of Indianapolis Affordable Housing Program award application. In just three years, MCP has committed more than $131 million in equity investments supporting affordable housing and community development projects across 24 Michigan counties .
